children: Fluoride-free, anti-sensitivity toothpaste — formulated with naturally derived Calcium Carbonate and Arginine — for whitening and sensitivity relief

KENNEBUNK, Maine, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As more consumers seek trusted fluoride-free oral care, Tom's of Maine is expanding its natural care portfolio with Hydroxyapatite Toothpaste, an anti-sensitivity toothpaste with naturally derived Arginine and Calcium Carbonate. Arginine, a naturally derived amino acid, and Calcium Carbonate, a naturally derived mineral, work together to reduce hypersensitivity, while Calcium Carbonate also helps whiten teeth by removing surface stains. It's now also formulated with hydroxyapatite, the primary mineral that makes up tooth enamel.

Tom's of Maine has spent more than 50 years being passionately committed to making products with naturally derived ingredients – and this formula  continues that commitment. The fluoride-free, SLS-free formula is vegan, gluten-free, and made without artificial flavors, sweeteners, dyes or potassium nitrate.

"We're meeting the demand for fluoride-free alternatives the Tom's of Maine way," said Cristiane Martini, VP, General Manager at Tom's of Maine & NA Sustainability. "For us, it's about creating more than just another ordinary toothpaste — harnessing the power of naturally derived ingredients, such as arginine and calcium carbonate, to deliver effective oral care, while staying true to what has always made Tom's different."
Tom's of Maine Hydroxyapatite is not an ordinary toothpaste.

Tom's of Maine Hydroxyapatite Toothpaste is available now in Gentle Mint flavor at Amazon.com for an MSRP of $11.99 (4.4 oz), with availability expanding to additional retailers in 2027.

About Tom's of Maine®
Tom's of Maine®, a Colgate-Palmolive® (

) company, has been making natural, safe, and effective personal care products for more than 50 years. It all began when Tom and Kate Chappell moved to Maine in 1968 looking for a healthier, simpler life for their growing family. And when they couldn't find personal care products that were free from artificial flavors, fragrances, sweeteners, colors and preservatives, they decided to make their own. Tom's of Maine products – including toothpaste, deodorant, mouthwash, bar soap, dental floss, and toothbrushes – are made from naturally sourced and derived ingredients. A Certified B Corporation, Tom's of Maine is committed to upholding a purpose-driven business and has a long-standing commitment to supporting nature and healthy families. Tom's of Maine has supported hundreds of nonprofits by giving back 10% of its annual profits, and employees are encouraged to use 5% of their paid time volunteering for causes they are passionate about.
